items.author: Conor Bergin

Damian Lillard on if he can imagine Portland without the Trail Blazers:

"As much as I'm a Trail Blazer, I'm a Portland person. ... I just don't see that happening. And hopefully that's what it ends up being. I just don't see a world where the Blazers aren't in Portland."

items.title: Damian Lillard on ownership/lease/relocation talks: "I've embraced Portland. This is my second home. Oakland is where I'm from, but Portland is my second home. I just don't see that happening. I don't see a world where the Trail Blazers aren't in Portland."
